suite: M1 server SQLite, guarded setup, and credential maintenance
command: cd server && MIX_HOME="$PWD/../.cache/mix" HEX_HOME="$PWD/../.cache/hex" MIX_ENV=test mix test --no-start test/vault/{maintenance_guard,credentials,game_store}_test.exs
observed: Version-one Ecto migration, exact declared schema and immutable history constraints, and effective WAL/FULL/foreign key/100 ms settings.
Checkpoint compare-and-swap and original request receipt readback; one solve per original attempt and one claim per original binding.
Durable exact-report deduplication and same-sequence contradiction retention; Begin retry after replacement, serialized Close/replacement, and rejection of Reset before required closure.
Independent VM contention, owner crash and partial markers, explicit recovery, canonical directory alias, and ownership-checked cleanup.
Exclusive mode-0600 key file creation and file/directory synchronization, rejected existing/symlink/bad output, guarded local simulator stop and stopped host replacement.

A real competing SQLite writer prevented activation after protected output creation. Status preserved the old active epoch and reported the orphan inactive. A separate run lost the task reply after commit and status verified the new active epoch.

Host, player and device credentials retain independent scopes. Browser session validation rejects invalid scope/epoch, logout and expired or forged session values; attempt throttling bounds repeated exchanges.
Stopped lost-key replacement preserved terminal and unresolved release history across paused checkpoint restart, including no reconstructed dispatch and the distinct Reset gates.
Revocation during a held SQLite writer prevented both a new checkpoint and retrieval of an earlier private operation receipt.
limits: The lost-reply case terminates the task VM after successful activation and before reporting success. An interruption inside SQLite COMMIT with unknown durability was not injected.
SQLite settings and APFS file/directory sync were observed. Power-cut survival and storage-device guarantees were not tested.
The suite exercises real SQLite and the in-process simulated box. Browser route and hardware verification are separate.
